1	import type { ActionService } from '../actions/action_service'
2	import { ACTION_PERSISTENCE_CHANGED_EVENT } from '../actions/action_service_events'
3	import type { DataService } from '../data/data_service'
4	import { register } from '../service_injector'
5	import type { OpenFilesService } from '../open_files_service'
6	import { stageMarkdownEditors } from './markdown_editor_staging'
7	
8	export type LocalSaveState = 'dirty' | 'saved' | 'saving'
9	
10	export interface ProjectPersistenceSnapshot {
11	    hasPendingPush: boolean
12	    hasPendingSave: boolean
13	    localSaveState: LocalSaveState
14	}
15	
16	export interface ProjectPersistenceServiceDependencies {
17	    actionService: ActionService
18	    dataService: DataService
19	    openFilesService: OpenFilesService
20	}
21	
22	const INITIAL_SNAPSHOT: ProjectPersistenceSnapshot = {
23	    hasPendingPush: false,
24	    hasPendingSave: false,
25	    localSaveState: 'saved',
26	}
27	const MAX_FLUSH_PASSES = 5
28	
29	export class ProjectPersistenceService extends EventTarget {
30	    private dependencies: ProjectPersistenceServiceDependencies | null = null
31	    private snapshot = INITIAL_SNAPSHOT
32	
33	    constructor() {
34	        super()
35	        register('projectPersistenceService', this)
36	    }
37	
38	    init(dependencies: ProjectPersistenceServiceDependencies) {
39	        if (
40	            this.dependencies?.actionService === dependencies.actionService
41	            && this.dependencies.dataService === dependencies.dataService
42	            && this.dependencies.openFilesService === dependencies.openFilesService
43	        ) return
44	
45	        this.removeDependencyListeners()
46	        this.dependencies = dependencies
47	        dependencies.actionService.addEventListener(ACTION_PERSISTENCE_CHANGED_EVENT, this.handleDependencyChanged)
48	        dependencies.dataService.addEventListener('persistenceChanged', this.handleDependencyChanged)
49	        dependencies.openFilesService.addEventListener('documentChanged', this.handleDependencyChanged)
50	        dependencies.openFilesService.addEventListener('removed', this.handleDependencyChanged)
51	        this.reconcileSnapshot()
52	    }
53	
54	    getSnapshot(): ProjectPersistenceSnapshot {
55	        return this.snapshot
56	    }
57	
58	    async flushPendingChanges() {
59	        const { actionService, dataService, openFilesService } = this.requireDependencies()
60	        for (let pass = 0; pass < MAX_FLUSH_PASSES; pass += 1) {
61	            if (!stageMarkdownEditors()) throw new Error('A Markdown editor could not stage its pending changes')
62	            if (actionService.draftStore.hasPendingDrafts()) await actionService.draftStore.flushDrafts()
63	            for (const document of openFilesService.getRegisteredDocuments()) {
64	                if (document.kind === 'card' && document.dirty) {
65	                    dataService.cards.updateCardBody(document.path, document.getDraft().content, document.createSaveReference())
66	                }
67	                if (document.kind === 'instruction' && document.dirty) {
68	                    const file = { content: document.getDraft().content, path: document.path }
69	                    dataService.scheduleFileCommit(file, `Update ${file.path}`, document.createSaveReference())
70	                }
71	            }
72	            if (dataService.getPersistenceSnapshot().hasPendingFileCommit) await dataService.cards.flushPendingCommits()
73	            await dataService.drainPendingStorageWrites()
74	            this.reconcileSnapshot()
75	            if (this.getPendingSaveBlockers().length === 0) return
76	        }
77	
78	        const pendingSaveBlockers = this.getPendingSaveBlockers()
79	        throw new Error(`Pending changes remain after flush: ${pendingSaveBlockers.join(', ')}`)
80	    }
81	
82	    private readonly handleDependencyChanged = () => {
83	        this.reconcileSnapshot()
84	    }
85	
86	    private reconcileSnapshot() {
87	        const { actionService, dataService, openFilesService } = this.requireDependencies()
88	        const { hasPendingFileCommit, hasPendingPush, isSaving } = dataService.getPersistenceSnapshot()
89	        const hasDirtyDocument = openFilesService.getRegisteredDocuments().some(({ dirty }) => dirty)
90	        const hasPendingSave = isSaving || hasPendingFileCommit || hasDirtyDocument || actionService.draftStore.hasPendingDrafts()
91	        const nextSnapshot: ProjectPersistenceSnapshot = {
92	            hasPendingPush,
93	            hasPendingSave,
94	            localSaveState: isSaving ? 'saving' : hasPendingSave ? 'dirty' : 'saved',
95	        }
96	        if (ProjectPersistenceService.isSameSnapshot(this.snapshot, nextSnapshot)) return
97	
98	        this.snapshot = nextSnapshot
99	        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<ProjectPersistenceSnapshot>('changed', { detail: nextSnapshot }))
100	    }
101	
102	    private removeDependencyListeners() {
103	        if (!this.dependencies) return
104	
105	        this.dependencies.actionService.removeEventListener(ACTION_PERSISTENCE_CHANGED_EVENT, this.handleDependencyChanged)
106	        this.dependencies.dataService.removeEventListener('persistenceChanged', this.handleDependencyChanged)
107	        this.dependencies.openFilesService.removeEventListener('documentChanged', this.handleDependencyChanged)
108	        this.dependencies.openFilesService.removeEventListener('removed', this.handleDependencyChanged)
109	    }
110	
111	    private getPendingSaveBlockers() {
112	        const { actionService, dataService, openFilesService } = this.requireDependencies()
113	        const { hasPendingFileCommit, isSaving } = dataService.getPersistenceSnapshot()
114	        const dirtyDocuments = openFilesService.getRegisteredDocuments()
115	            .filter(({ dirty }) => dirty)
116	            .map(({ kind, path }) => `${kind} document ${path}`)
117	        const blockers = [...dirtyDocuments]
118	        if (actionService.draftStore.hasPendingDrafts()) blockers.push('action drafts')
119	        if (hasPendingFileCommit) blockers.push(`file commit batch: ${dataService.describePendingFileCommits().join(', ')}`)
120	        if (isSaving) blockers.push('storage writes')
121	
122	        return blockers
123	    }
124	
125	    private requireDependencies() {
126	        if (!this.dependencies) throw new Error('Project persistence service is not initialized')
127	
128	        return this.dependencies
129	    }
130	
131	    private static isSameSnapshot(first: ProjectPersistenceSnapshot, second: ProjectPersistenceSnapshot) {
132	        return first.hasPendingPush === second.hasPendingPush
133	            && first.hasPendingSave === second.hasPendingSave
134	            && first.localSaveState === second.localSaveState
135	    }
136	}
137	
138	export const projectPersistenceService = new ProjectPersistenceService()

38	## Findings
39	
40	- Switching actions changes the `ActionPopupSession` key in `action_popup_content.tsx`. React remounts the session, including the popup frame, selectors, controls, and Markdown editor, and creates new action-specific stores.
41	- The switch blocks the renderer for approximately 386 ms. Prompt preparation starts around 1.856 s; the prepared draft replaces the editor content around 2.778 s. The editor becomes editable around 2.80 s, approximately 1.32 s after the click.
42	- `defaultPreparePrompt` currently flushes all pending project changes before calling the desktop backend. The trace cannot separate persistence, bridge, and backend costs within the approximately 920 ms preparation interval.
43	- Development/debugger instrumentation amplifies the recorded activity. Measure improvements in a production build as well.
44	
45	## Required changes
46	
47	### 1. Flush action definitions only during prompt preparation
48	
49	In `action_popup_defaults.ts`, replace the project-wide flush in `defaultPreparePrompt` with the existing action draft store's `flushDrafts()` when action drafts are pending. Preparation must use current action definitions and report flush failures through the existing error path.
50	
51	Keep the full project flush before execution in `electron_action_runner.ts`. Prompt preparation must not stage or save unrelated card and instruction editors, or drain unrelated storage writes.
52	
53	### 2. Keep the popup frame mounted across action switches
54	
55	Move the stable popup surface outside the action-keyed session boundary. Refactor `action_popup_content.tsx`, `action_popup_session.tsx`, and `action_popup_frame.tsx` so switching actions updates the selected action and active bindings without remounting `ResizablePopper`, the typeahead provider, or the shared header and action selector.
56	
57	Action-specific subscriptions must follow the selected bindings. Preserve popup position, size, expansion, and drag behavior. Keep model and view state in services; the stable layout must not reuse the previous action's run or conversation state.
58	
59	### 3. Keep the prompt editor mounted between agent actions
60	
61	Refactor `agent_action.tsx`, `action_prompt_owner.tsx`, and `action_agent_prompt.tsx` so the editor survives agent-to-agent switches and binds to the selected action's draft. Reuse the existing draft-binding behavior in `MarkdownEditor` / `useMarkdownDraft`; retain separate drafts through `ActionPromptDraftService`.
62	
63	Flush the outgoing editor buffer before rebinding, then replace content from the incoming draft. Clear action-specific editor history and transient search/typeahead state when rebinding. Preserve loading/read-only behavior and ensure late preparation results update only their owning draft. Agent-to-command switches may remount the editor when its configuration changes.

66	
67	Add focused regression coverage for action-only preparation flushes and full execution flushes; frame/editor preservation across agent switches; draft preservation during rapid A-to-B-to-A switches; late preparation results; conversation selection and active-run routing; and agent-to-command transitions. entries.content: Confirmed it: a dirty editor can bypass the batcher entirely — typing in a card body only updates the draft, and flush() only fires on switch/unmount/blur/window events, none of which trigger when clicking a card's action button while it stays mounted. That means stale card text gets read with no ENOENT, silently dropping any card references just typed.
